features.name: Add tasks
features.description: Users can add new tasks to their to-do list.

features.name: Mark tasks as done
features.description: Users can mark tasks as done after completing them.

features.name: Delete tasks
features.description: Users can delete tasks from their to-do list.

constraints: Tasks must be stored in a database.
Tasks must be accessible to the user who created them.
acceptance_criteria: A user can add a new task to their to-do list.
A user can mark a task as done after completing it.
A user can delete a task from their to-do list.
